jobs.purpose: Inspect Windows, Docker, PostgreSQL, ports, filesystem layout, service accounts and resource capacity without changing the host.
Request D-group-owned local install or update using locked manifests and pre-action snapshot.
Request D group to start the local service and return health/readiness evidence.
Request D group to stop the local service gracefully and preserve receipts.
Request stop/start with recovery to the prior known-good state on failure.
Read service, database, API, disk, backup freshness and loopback bind health.
Request a new backup artifact without deleting or replacing existing backups.
Restore a backup only into an isolated smoke target and verify readback.
Collect bounded logs, manifests and receipt pointers with secret redaction.
